about: Error responses exactly as goinfer serve sent them to POST /v1/chat/completions, captured 2026-09-14 on nobara-pc (Qwen2.5-0.5B, CPU), for the W13 gate in scripts/webui_app_gate.mjs. Each was provoked for real: -api-key with no key, an unknown model, -max-queue 1 under concurrent load, -max-inflight 1 under concurrent load, a K5 halt through -admin-socket, and a 30 MB prompt (which the context pre-check rejects before any 413 — the 413 shape was not reachable at default settings and is not recorded here).
